reviews.text:
Good service and friendliness. I recommend it.
A year later, I regret that they caused a wound on Nina's snout that bled quite a bit and they didn't even inform me. She had to be treated and is taking anti-inflammatory medication because her mouth swelled up on the right side. Even more regrettable was that I informed the company of what happened and they replied that they appreciated the information and to wait a moment, to this day. No apology, no concern for Nina. They lost a customer.
We recently moved to Lisbon and we have a Bichon Maltese dog who has already been bathed by them twice; they have left her beautiful and very clean.

Excellent service, they paid special attention and took great care of my baby, the service is 5 stars.
I highly recommend them.

We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your preference and for the 5 stars. Knowing that you trust our work to care for your pet is our greatest reward.

A big hug from the entire Cila Baths and Grooming team!

Thank you so much for your kind words and 4 stars!

We are so happy to know that you trusted our work to care for your little boy.

We are always working to make the experience 5 stars!

If there is anything we can improve for your next visit, please let us know!

See you soon!
I love them, they're fantastic!
Very professional. They did a good job and did what I wanted.

Thank you so much for your feedback!

We work and dedicate ourselves daily to offering the best bathing and grooming service at a fair price.

We hope to see you again soon!
Excellent service!! Our dog looks super clean and beautiful. We'll definitely be back!!

Thank you so much for your feedback and for trusting us to care for your furry friend.

We are very happy to know you had a good experience with us!

We work every day to offer the best possible service and care.

If there is anything we can do to make your next visit a 5-star experience, we would love to hear your suggestion.

See you soon!

I came here completely SCARED by the videos I saw on this company's profile. All the videos show a lack of respect for animals and a lack of professionalism with customers. But I arrived and was even more shocked by the comments left here... MISTREATING A 15-YEAR-OLD SENIOR DOG because they don't know how to work should be punished by law. I hope that his owner and the owners of so many others file a complaint with the police.

I certainly will. There is immense evidence of negligence on this company's profile. This place needs to be inspected immediately.

Response: At no point did I say that I was served by the service. I was very explicit about what made me write: the comments here, PUBLIC for everyone to read, that specifically talk about excessive force on a 15-year-old senior animal, and I mentioned the videos on social media that prove a huge lack of knowledge in animal behavior.

We completely repudiate your review.

We have checked our schedule, our customer system, and our contact history, and we have no record of your name, your pet's name, or any service provided to you at Cila Banhos e Tosquias.

As the health, safety, and well-being of pets are our highest priority, we take this type of allegation very seriously. For this reason, we require that you publicly identify the following in your testimonial:

Your pet's name
The exact date and time you were at our store
The name of the person who made the appointment

If we did not provide any service to your animal, this review is entirely false and constitutes an act of defamation.

We request the immediate removal of this erroneous or malicious comment, reserving the right to take appropriate legal action to protect the good name of our company.

Thank you so much for your kind words! Our hearts are full knowing you loved your experience at Cila Baths and Grooming.

Caring for dogs and cats is our greatest passion, and we can't wait for your next visit.

See you soon!
To the professionals who cared for my pet, I want to say that they were impeccable and very efficient! Thank you, and I will definitely return.

Thank you for your 5-star review! We are proud and pleased to know that you enjoyed our work.

Taking care of your pet with all the love and dedication is always a joy for us.

We will always be available to welcome you back to Cila Baths and Grooming.
Great experience with my pet, I loved the service.

First of all, I want to say that I was a little worried because of the 1-star reviews. However, after my experience, I got the feeling that, in many of these cases, the problem may be a lack of attention on the part of the customers.
From the first contact, they were always very helpful. I was contacted and informed via WhatsApp throughout the process, and they explained everything very clearly. They warned me SEVERAL times about the fees, terms, and waiting times, so I really advise you to READ all the information and clarify any doubts before the service.
As it was my first time and my kitten is very spoiled, I was anxious and it was hard for me to leave him. But when he came home he was great, calm, and well cared for.
In my case, I used the pick-up, bath, and full grooming service, and everything went very well. I was satisfied with the result and the efficiency of the team.
I also saw some criticism on Facebook for refusing certain breeds considered potentially dangerous. In my opinion, that is not discrimination. If you don't have the conditions or capacity to handle these animals safely, it makes perfect sense that you shouldn't accept them.

My experience was very positive and I recommend it. 5 stars! Thank you! Snow thanks you 🥰🥰

Thank you so much for your 5-star review and for trusting our work at CILA!

We are extremely proud to know that you were happy with our bathing and grooming service.

We work every day to ensure that our furry friends not only leave looking beautiful and smelling wonderful, but also feel pampered and relaxed throughout the entire process.

Their affection and well-being are always our top priority!

Until your next visit!

First time since arriving in Portugal that I took my dog ​​to get a haircut, and I loved it!

He looks so cute. Thank you for the care and attention! 🐶❤️

I did a lot of research before hiring the service, but honestly, I regret not doing it sooner. They are excellent professionals. From the attention via WhatsApp, to the service from Mr. Ruben, the gentleman who picked up and delivered my pets, and the team that groomed, bathed, and left them smelling nice and cared for with so much love.

I will always be a customer and I am very grateful for your professionalism! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

On September 13th, 2024, I sent my two dogs, and one came back with a bleeding paw. I contacted them via WhatsApp, showing photos, and after some time the owner called me. She was extremely rude and didn't apologize for what happened (more than 5 minutes trying to justify the unjustifiable). Later, I received an email from the manager, who did apologize, but without taking any responsibility for what happened. I repeat what I told the lady on the phone: for me, there was a lack of professionalism on two counts: first, in not knowing how far to trim the nails (because my dog ​​is almost 6 years old, always goes to grooming places other than the other, and this has never happened before), and second, in not acting professionally in the face of the small accident. Trying to deflect as if it wasn't a mistake, a problem, or that it hadn't happened was terrible. It was the second time I sent them, and I don't intend to ever send them again. Neither time.

Outstanding experience! I couldn't be happier with the care my dog received and continue receiving. The staff are kind, professional, and genuinely caring. They kept me updated and made sure my dog was comfortable and happy throughout. It's clear they truly love animals. I highly recommend this company to anyone looking for trustworthy and exceptional pet care. Thank you CILA TEAM for taking such wonderful care of my furry friend in special to the owner, Celina. Obrigado!

I really liked the service provided by Cila Banhos, I recommend them 100%. My pet was in very bad shape, as if he had come from a war. They came 5 stars, they picked up my pet at the door and brought him back a few hours later, but everything was fine. 5-star service, I loved it. Thank you Cila Banhos.

This is the worst place you could possibly leave your dog.

The owner is extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. My experience with her was absolutely terrible and the customer service was shocking.

She claims that they call only 20 minutes before pickup, and if you arrive even 5 minutes after those 20 minutes, she threatens to charge an additional €35 per hour. On top of that, she constantly bombards customers with phone calls and messages. The excessive calls and pressure were so distracting that I nearly had a car accident.

I have never experienced such poor customer service. The owner was rude, aggressive, and showed no respect for her customers.

If you care about your dog and want to avoid an extremely stressful experience, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

DO NOT GO!
Really bad service. They took me almost 100€ for a service that was not done. I took my 7m Yorkshire to have a bath and higienic cut. Online they insisted in booking a scissors cut and after I would discuss with the groomer. With the groomer, I discussed it and it was decided higienic cut.
At the end they considered the cut (he has the same amount hair as yesterday...) and were rude, speaking after we left "I'm the one who knows what should be payed".
Additionally they took 40€ extra saying he had knots, and they didi it in 10 min (I imagine how many knots he had.... Not much).
This is not the first complain like that, from Google reviews.

Plus they are not careful with the dogs... They way they put them in the lap is like they were toys. Not careful at all.

After, they were rude in whatsapp. A complaint was open in livro de reclamações

Thank you so much for the 5 stars and for your kind words!

It's a huge privilege to take care of your pet and know that you trust our work. Seeing satisfied pet owners is our greatest reward.

We look forward to seeing you at the next session.

See you soon!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating and for your kind words!

We are immensely happy to know that you enjoyed our work at Cila Baths and Grooming. Caring for your pet with all the love, patience, and dedication is always our highest priority.

Knowing that we met your expectations is our greatest reward!

We look forward to your next visit for another moment of pampering and beauty.

See you soon!
High professionalism and immense friendliness.

13-year-old cat with little outdoor experience. Very long fur. I left a note about a wart that shouldn't be cut.

They checked everything, the cat wasn't even scared when I picked her up, and the fur was as I had requested: short but not so short that you could see the skin.

Excellent service.

We are very happy with your feedback!

At Cila Baths and Grooming, we work every day to provide the best comfort and care for our furry friends.

Thank you for your trust.

We loved it!! Our dog looked beautiful! We were very pleased with the service, the affection, the concern, and the initial conversation. Everything was very well explained, there were no doubts. Thank you Celina and team, and Ruben, for your kindness and care for our animals, who deserve EVERYTHING! VERY GRATEFUL. From the pick-up to her delivery. Praiseworthy and very grateful. Thank you!! We need more companies and professionals like this, humane and sensitive.

I don't even have words to describe the lack of professionalism at this establishment. Besides the exorbitant price, my dog ​​wasn't even groomed, the service was terrible, and the staff were incredibly rude. I wouldn't advise anyone to go to this place.

I'm very satisfied with the service! Nugget did the grooming and bathing, and the result was excellent. They were very professional, quick, and attentive. I recommend them without hesitation and will certainly return. Thank you!

Thank you very much for your positive feedback.
Our team works daily to ensure that the bathing and grooming service is a relaxing and high-quality experience for the animals.

We look forward to your visit very soon.
Five-star service, as usual! My little girl always comes back smelling wonderful and happy! And the little bows in her fur are a must! They truly deserve congratulations!

It was also a pleasure for me to work with you. The information, personal contacts, and service provided were far superior to other previous experiences. It's just a shame that the price is a little higher than my previous experiences, which may limit how often I would like to use Cila. But you can register Lolla and Mia as gained clients. We will be back.
Thank you very much and see you soon.
Manuela, Lola and Mia
I wasn't present during the bathing and grooming process. But the final result was very good :)
I liked the haircut, just as I had requested, and the friendliness of the Cila team! Lolita will be back to repeat the experience.

We are immensely grateful for your preference and 5-star review.

At Cila, we work daily to ensure the utmost well-being and comfort of our furry friends during bathing and grooming.

It's gratifying to see this effort recognized.

Until your next visit!

Thank you so much for your kindness and trust in our work.

We are very happy to know that you liked the result!

Taking care of kittens requires patience and love, and it's a pleasure to welcome yours.

Until your next visit!
Excellent service! Everything was very well done and they provided assistance from start to finish.

Thank you so much for the 5 stars!

At CILA, we work to ensure that bathing and grooming is a relaxing and excellent experience for every animal.

We are pleased to know that we exceeded your expectations.

Until your next visit!

Excellent service.
Punctual pickup and delivery.
My cat looked beautiful.

For me, the best place to take care of your pet...
My dog ​​Breno is a regular customer and every time I take him there I always come back with the certainty that he was well treated and well cared for.
Above all, they don't just do work, they do it with a lot of love.

Guys, the entire Cila team deserves congratulations.
Impeccable bath and breed-specific cut!
Our little Rafi got a lovely cut, and the staff were very nice. Will come back :)

Terrible experience. I don't recommend it and I'll never go back. The owner is very rude. They don't research the breed before grooming.
If you want to know about the service here: Beware! They don't follow instructions and don't accept feedback.
I have a long-haired dachshund, and I was very specific that I didn't want anything cut except the back and that the breed's fringes should be left. The dog was groomed all the way to the tail, legs, skirt, and the breed's tie (which I also asked them not to touch)! When I picked up the dog, the attendant asked me if I liked it.

I calmly said no, that they should check the breed's cut before cutting everything.

The lady, apparently the owner, started yelling, "You'll have to pay! You'll have to pay! It doesn't matter! What you asked was done!!!"
In short, I didn't consider not paying; I wanted to explain, so I could go back and leave more satisfied.
The service was good, I was very well taken care of. My dogs came out clean and happy, I'm considering returning.

Clay, after his bath at "Cila Banhos e Tosquias". 😍
Impeccable service. They pick up and drop off your pet 😍 …
